Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I enclose what [Mrs Blackburn](/person/159) says in answer to my question about the drawings for the [Little Duke](/book/20) - Will you tell me what you think of the matter? I suppose she might improve some of the faces, but I think it is quite open to you to find some other designer. I shall send tomorrow another parcel of [the Trial](/book/53)
Yours faithfully
C.M. Yonge
